workflows.title: Intracellular O-GlcNAc Mass Spectrometry on Motor Complexes

steps.name: Protein Extraction & Immunoprecipitation
steps.details: Native lysis of root or cell cultures to preserve cytoskeletal complexes (e.g. Myosin XI, Dynactin p150Glued, Kinesin-4/12). OGA inhibitor (Thiamet-G) added to prevent post-lysis deglycosylation.

steps.name: Chemoenzymatic or Lectin Enrichment
steps.details: Concanavalin A (ConA) or succinylated Wheat Germ Agglutinin (sWGA) affinity chromatography, or metabolic labeling with UDP-GalNAz followed by copper-free click chemistry biotinylation.

steps.name: Protease Digestion (Trypsin / Glu-C)
steps.details: Orthogonal protease digestion to produce ideal peptide lengths (8-25 amino acids) surrounding Ser/Thr O-GlcNAc sites in motor neck and tail domains.

steps.name: Stepped HCD-EThcD Mass Spectrometry
steps.details: Electron-Transfer/Higher-Energy Collision Dissociation (EThcD) fragmentation preserves the labile glycosidic bond (GlcNAc oxonium ion at m/z 204.08) while fragmenting peptide backbone c/z ions for unambiguous site localization.

steps.name: Database Search & Yin-Yang Phosphorylation Mapping
steps.details: Byonic and O-GlcNAcAtlas spectral matching. Evaluation of reciprocal O-GlcNAcylation vs phosphorylation switches regulating motor processivity.

steps.name: Alcohol Insoluble Residue (AIR) Preparation
steps.details: Root tissues from ISS spaceflight and KSC ground controls are homogenized in liquid N2 and washed with ethanol, chloroform, and acetone to isolate cell wall structural matrix.

steps.name: Sequential Chemical Fractionation
steps.details: Six-stage chemical extraction: 50mM CDTA (pectin) → 50mM Na2CO3 (pectin) → 1M KOH (loosely bound hemicellulose) → 4M KOH (tightly bound hemicellulose) → Chlorite (lignin) → 4M KOH post-chlorite.

steps.name: Dialysis, Lyophilization & 384-Well Coating
steps.details: Extracts are dialyzed exhaustively against water to remove extraction salts and coated at standardized carbohydrate concentrations onto 384-well microplates.

steps.name: Robotic ELISA with 155 Monoclonal mAbs
steps.details: Automated ELISA workstation screens the extract against 155 glycan-directed monoclonal antibodies targeting xyloglucan, xylan, HG, RG-I, and AGP epitopes.

steps.name: Optical Density Quantitation & Heatmap Generation
steps.details: OD450 optical absorbance quantifies relative epitope abundance across ground and microgravity treatments.

steps.name: Data Curation & Harmonization
steps.details: Integration of OSD-615 glycomics with companion Veggie RNA-Seq (OSD-218/217) and metadata.

steps.name: Sparse PLS & Factorization
steps.details: mixOmics sPLS-DA and Bayesian MOFA2 factorization to find shared variance across transcripts and wall epitopes.

steps.name: Interactome Modeling (STRING / AraNet)
steps.details: Network topology connecting differentially expressed kinesins/myosins with matrix synthases.

steps.name: Dynamic Vesicle Transport Simulation
steps.details: Stochastic Monte Carlo modeling of motor-driven secretory vesicle flux to cell plate and cell wall in microgravity.
